description.en: Open-source, animation-ready React components and blocks built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Motion, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui for SaaS and AI apps.
description.zh: 面向 SaaS 与 AI 产品的开源动态 React 组件库：基于 Next.js、Tailwind CSS、Motion 与 shadcn/ui 深度打造。

content.en: Spectrum UI is an animation-first component library created for modern SaaS landing pages, AI agent applications, and design-led products. Built on the shadcn/ui foundation with Motion and Tailwind CSS, it offers over 50 copy-paste components and blocks featuring neon glow borders, interactive spotlight cards, shimmer effects, physics-based magnetic cursors, and fluid bento layouts, complete with an official MCP server for AI coding assistants.
content.zh: Spectrum UI 是一套以动效为核心竞争力的开源组件与区块库，专为现代 SaaS 官网、AI 交互系统与独立开发者产品打造。底层架构深度融合 shadcn/ui 哲学、Motion 动画库与 Tailwind CSS，收录了逾 50 款涵盖流光边框、鼠标聚光灯追踪卡片、磨砂浮动导航坞、微噪点渐变背景、磁吸悬停按钮及便当盒网格的高阶动效组件，并官方提供 MCP Server 助力 AI 编程助手秒级调用。
